zh-CN.title: QQ 历史身份更清晰
items: 回复层主的历史评论会直接归入对应楼层，不再重复显示 @昵称
尚未认领的用户会显示 QQ 来源标签和 QQ 头像，点击即可查看历史身份资料
评论中的 QQ 提及会额外标记，并在对方绑定后自动关联新账号

en.title: Clearer historical QQ identities
items: Replies to a thread owner now sit directly in that thread without repeating an @name prefix
Unclaimed users now show a QQ source tag and avatar, with historical identity details available on click
QQ mentions are clearly marked and follow the user when they claim their identity
